results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_for_rent) AS rent_listings,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_for_rent) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS rent_share_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all;
results.answer: Across all time, 12,947 listings have been posted, 3,231 of them were offered for rent, which is 24.96% of all listings.

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT
  la.category,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.deals d ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.completed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: Across the nine categories, the average time to sell an item ranges from 11.20 days for bikes_transport to 12.08 days for other; clothing (11.32 days), dorm_essentials (11.39 days), electronics (11.40 days), furniture (11.61 days), kitchen (11.49 days), sports_outdoors (11.56 days) and textbooks (11.56 days).

results.question: average rating buyers give sellers, by item category

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS requests,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS request_share_pct
FROM nlq.conversations c
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON c.item_id = la.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY request_share_pct DESC;
results.answer: Across all time, the share of conversations that led to a request was highest at Marino Recreation Center (63.61%), West Village (63.55%) and International Village (63.00%). The other spots ranged from 62.91% at Fenway (off campus) down to 61.45% at Curry Student Center.

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.period,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rentals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS late_return_rate_percent
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.period IN ('finals', 'classes')
GROUP BY c.period
ORDER BY c.period;
results.answer: The late‑return rate for rentals due during finals is 18.66%, which is slightly lower than the 19.66% rate for rentals due during regular classes.
